title: Settings in One Window
summary: Settings opens from the sidebar gear with every page reachable from a single navigation rail.
titleNarration: Welcome to this sprint's Whaleshark demo, where we walk through the new Settings window.

proves.subtitle: A short walk through the new Settings window

cards.title: One entry point
cards.text: The gear in the sidebar footer opens Settings as a single window.

cards.title: One navigation rail
cards.text: Every settings page, from Overview to Archive, is listed in one rail.

cards.title: Appearance at a glance
cards.text: The Appearance page shows the color scheme choices and the themes.

cards.title: Shared by design
cards.text: Skills and MCP servers are kept per machine and shared across the machines you connect.

proves.outcome: Demo outcome: Settings is a single window where every page is one click away in the rail.
proves.narration: This demo proves that Settings is now one window, opened from the gear in the sidebar footer, with every page listed in a single navigation rail. We visit Appearance, then Skills and MCP servers, which are kept per machine and shared across the machines you connect.

steps.title: Step 1: Finding your way around Settings
steps.subtitle: From the sidebar gear to every settings page
narration: We start by clicking the gear icon at the bottom left of the sidebar.
Next we click Appearance in the navigation rail to open its page.
Then we click Skills in the same rail to visit that page.
Finally we click MCP servers, leaving the window open on that page.

close.message: Settings is now one window with one rail, so every page is a single click away.
close.delivered: A single Settings window with a full navigation rail, opened from the sidebar gear.
close.next: Next sprint we populate Skills and MCP servers from connected machines and cover more pages.
close.value: You can reach any setting without hunting through separate dialogs.
close.narration: That is the new Settings for this sprint. One window, one rail, and every page a single click away. Next sprint we will populate Skills and MCP servers from connected machines and walk through more pages. Thanks for watching.
